Question 2
?

Find gxy(x,y)+gxx(x,y) given that gx(x,y)=xx2+y2.

a
y2−2xy−x2(x2+y2)2
b
2y2−x2(x2+y2)2
c
y2+2xy−x2(x2+y2)2
d
(y−x)2(x2+y2)2
e
y2−2x2(x2+y2)2
